coverage_note: Both API directions returned the same call IDs in the requested window. Counts describe the source-exposed listing and do not measure receiver coverage. Zero-count dates are included.

collection.pid_note: The pids field lists the transmitting radio or unit IDs exposed as srcList[].src by OpenMHz. The API does not expose a separate PID field. Missing IDs remain empty.
